mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased wage pressures and reduced corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPIAUCSL is increasing, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200k, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and reduced profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS MoM > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing and related goods, boosting economic activity and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < 0 for 2 consecutive quarters.
